zh.CATEGORY: AI 演示文稿 / 视觉叙事平台（ai-presentation · docs-decks-sites）
zh.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: 它卖的不是 PPT，是「一段想法直接变成能给人看的东西」——把审美做成工作流，把人类判断嵌进管道。
zh.USER_SCALE: 两个口径并存，都按原文写：官网首页自述「超过 1 亿用户的社区」；Gamma 自家文档页引用创始人 Grant Lee 2025-11-10 的数字——全球 7000 万以上用户、每月新建约 3000 万个 gamma（每天 100 万以上）。同一页还写着 ARR 超过 1 亿美元、2023 年起盈利、账上现金多于累计融资、团队不到 50 人、6800 万美元 B 轮由 a16z 领投、估值 21 亿美元。官网数字更高，属营销口径，本卡不做换算。
zh.STAGE_MATURITY: 规模化成熟期：付费墙完整（免费 / Plus / Pro / Ultra / 企业定制），模型外采、产品自研，团队不到 50 人即做到 1 亿美元 ARR 量级（据其公开自述），说明增长不靠堆人，靠模板密度与分发。
zh.BUSINESS_MODEL_SHORT: Freemium + 积分制订阅：Free、Plus、Pro、Ultra 四档（个人），企业/商业版按席位定制；积分（credits）是通用计价单位。
zh.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: 它把「审美」做成了流水线，把「判断」留成了人工节点——墙不在生成，在场景与模板的密度。
zh.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: 它不是一次 prompt 出一份稿，而是把任务拆成多个节点，每个节点都让人确认一次；模型是外采的，产品能力长在编排与模板上。所以它的威胁不是模型被追平，而是「审美」这件事被通用工具变成默认值。
zh.TLDR_1_HEADLINE: 审美是它唯一不可替代的东西
zh.TLDR_1_BODY: 实测第一感受不是「能生成」，是「它很好看」：内置的场景与版式把下限抬起来了，原来要么花钱找设计师、要么自己做得很难看。
zh.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: 门槛在设计工作流，不在模型
zh.TLDR_2_BODY: 模型是 Claude、ChatGPT + DALL·E、Gemini、Flux 等外采组件（官网 FAQ 自述）；它自己的资产是流程编排、模板与交互，这才是别人难追的部分。
zh.TLDR_3_HEADLINE: 最脆的那根梁：配额刹车与中文场景
zh.TLDR_3_BODY: 实测生成 20 张只落 10 张，直接被推去付费——付费墙立得早，口碑风险也在这儿；另外英文优先的模板与排版，中文场景要自己补。
zh.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: Gamma 是一个「输入一段想法、输出可对外发布的成品」的平台：演示、文档、网站、社媒图文、图片都能出，导入导出支持 PPTX / PDF / PNG / Google 幻灯片，另有 25+ 连接器与公共 API。
zh.USER_PROMISE: 别再为「做得好看」这件事付费给设计师或熬夜排版——把想法说清楚，剩下的交给它的场景与工作流。
zh.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: 一周三份提案、每份都要好看且不能撞模板；实测点名的第一类人。它们买的是「表达速度 + 专业观感」。
zh.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: 同一份内容要同时变演示、落地页、社媒图文；实测点名的第二、三类人，买的是「一次输入多形态输出」。
zh.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: 课件、培训材料、季度汇报；官网把教育、销售、创业 pitch 都列成场景，这一层对价格敏感但用量稳定。
zh.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: 把想法变成一份能直接发出去的成品
zh.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: 不再担心「做得难看」丢面子
zh.JTBD_SOCIAL: 被看成表达专业、审美在线的人
zh.FREQUENCY: 事件驱动但高频：周会、提案、季度汇报，每月 2 到 8 次（按场景类型估）
zh.USAGE_CONTEXT: 桌面端为主（浏览器内工作台），产出常回流到 PPT / 邮件 / 微信 / 官网
zh.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: 有一个必须对外表达的场合——汇报、提案、路演、课程
zh.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: 描述需求 → 选场景与风格 → 大纲 → 布局 → 逐节点确认或改写 → 导出/发布
zh.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: 一份可以直接投屏、可以直接发链接的成品，而不是半成品草稿
zh.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: 品牌主题、模板、历史项目留在工作区里，下次从「上次那套」开始，切换成本反过来变成留人理由
zh.LOOP_FREQ: 每份稿一次完整循环，每月 2 到 8 轮
zh.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: 触发点是日历上的场次，不是产品推送
zh.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: 它教的不是工具，是「一份好稿长什么样」的判断标准——用久了会被它的审美驯化。
zh.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: 模板与场景页吃搜索长尾（「XX 主题 演示」直接落到成品模板）→ 生成的作品带出处 → 看的人问「这用什么做的」→ 回流成新用户。
zh.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: 第一次看到生成结果不是「AI 味排版」，是真的能上会——实测的第一反应就是「它很好看」。
zh.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: 弱社交裂变、强作品外溢：生成物本身是广告位，但产品没有把「分享即拉新」做成显式机制（免费版保留品牌标识，是唯一强制的曝光）。
zh.RETENTION_1: 品牌主题与工作区资产沉淀
zh.RETENTION_2: 场景库越用越熟，换工具要重学
zh.RETENTION_3: 导出回 PPTX 的习惯被满足——不锁死格式，反而降低了心理防线
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: 海量公开 gamma（每月 3000 万个新建）本身就是被搜索引擎收录的长尾页，形成内容自生长
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: 成品被投屏、被转发、被嵌在别人的网页里，观看者即潜在用户；免费版品牌标识把这个环闭得更紧
zh.SURFACE_1_ROLE: 入口：说一句需求，它给大纲与初稿；实测评价是「对话框有场景化引导，对新手有帮助」
zh.SURFACE_2_ROLE: 主工作台：智能布局与自由编辑可切换，颗粒度由人决定
zh.SURFACE_3_ROLE: Pro 起：自定义品牌、字体配色统一，保证「像我公司做的」
zh.SURFACE_4_ROLE: 同一份内容切演示 / 文档 / 网站 / 社媒 / 图片，官网把这条路写成核心卖点
zh.SURFACE_5_ROLE: PDF、PPTX 导入无损还原，导出 PPTX / PDF / PNG / Google 幻灯片；25+ 连接器接既有素材源
zh.SURFACE_6_ROLE: 自定义域名（Pro 10 个、Ultra 100 个）+ 分析面板，产出可以直接当网站上线
zh.ENTITY_1: Gamma（一份作品，可当演示/文档/站点）
zh.ENTITY_2: 卡片（card，最小内容单元，可拖动重排）
zh.ENTITY_3: 主题 / 品牌（theme，统一视觉的容器）
zh.ENTITY_4: 积分（credits，AI 动作的计价单位）
zh.ENTITY_5: 工作区（workspace，团队资产与权限的边界）
zh.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: 信息架构是「作品为中心」而不是「功能为中心」：一个 gamma 既是文档也是演示也是站点，形态在导出时才决定。这种「先内容后形态」的顺序，是它和传统 PPT 工具最大的结构差异——后者一上来就让你选版式。
zh.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: 交互是「先谈需求、再谈排版」：对话框收集上下文 → 出大纲 → 出卡片 → 人在卡片上改。实测的观察是，它刻意在管道里放了多个「人类判断」节点，而不是一键生成到底；这也是它为什么不像抽卡。
zh.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: 不让用户面对空白画布，先问「你要做什么场合的东西」；实测结论：对新手有帮助
zh.CRAFT_2_NAME: 智能布局 + 自由编辑
zh.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: 默认不让你碰像素，要碰就给到底；同一份内容可以在两种颗粒度间来回切
zh.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: 官网 FAQ 明列在用 Claude、ChatGPT + DALL·E、Gemini、Flux、Recraft、Playground、Ideogram、Luma、Leonardo——按环节挑模型，是工程而不是信仰
zh.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: PDF / PPTX 导入导出保结构，等于承认用户还要回 Office 交差，不逼人搬家
zh.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: 主题、模板、历史项目可复用，第二份稿开始变快，履约成本随时间下降
zh.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: 它的原则是「把审美变成默认值，把判断留给人」——所以它不去做全自动，而是把人的每一次选择做成流程里的一站。
zh.TTV_LABEL: 价值到达时间：本次未测（实测只记流程：看懂场景 → 进工作台 → 对话下单 → 出初稿 → 改到能发）
zh.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: 实测没有秒表，也没有「第几分钟」的记录，本卡不换算成分钟、不编评分。可确认的是：第一份稿出来之前，人要回答若干场景与判断问题。
zh.COG_LABEL: 认知负荷：低（对话框带场景引导，新手不用先学排版；难点在「要什么效果」而不在「按钮在哪」）
zh.DELIGHT_1: 开场就不是白纸：场景与模板先把下限抬到「不难看」
zh.DELIGHT_2: 同一份内容换形态：演示、文档、网站、社媒一次出
zh.DELIGHT_3: 能直接对外发——实测原话「它很好看」，不需要再找设计师过一遍
zh.DELIGHT_LABEL: 惊喜点：审美兜底 + 一稿多形态 + 产出可直接对外
zh.TRUST_LABEL: 信任：模型来源公开（官网 FAQ 逐家列出），企业侧有 SSO、SOC 2 文档与数据控制；短板是本次两个评论源都没抓到（Product Hunt 403、G2 抓取失败），所以没有任何第三方评分背书，本卡也不引用分数。
zh.STRUGGLE_1: 配额刹车立得早：免费 400 积分、单次最多 10 页，实测生成 20 张只落 10 张就被推去付费
zh.STRUGGLE_2: 审美同质化：模板越密，越容易被认出来「这是 Gamma 做的」
zh.STRUGGLE_3: 中文与本土场景：英文优先的版式与素材，中文排版、本土案例要自己补
zh.STRUGGLE_LABEL: 摩擦：配额墙、模板同质化、中文场景
zh.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: 四档个人订阅（Plus US$9/月、Pro US$18/月、Ultra US$90/月，均为年缴折月价，年缴分别 US$108 / 216 / 1080）+ 企业/商业版按成员计价；积分是消耗单位，按账号计费、团队多成员即多份。
zh.MON_ENTRY_HEADLINE: 入口不需要免费到底：400 积分给到「够试、不够交差」
zh.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: 免费额度只够摸清产品，单次上限 10 页也刚好卡在「能看不能交」；第一次被卡住时，最自然的动作就是升 Plus。
zh.FREE_PAID_BOUNDARY_NAME: 墙在「一次能出多少」和「能不能去掉品牌」
zh.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: Free：400 积分（注册即赠）、单次最多 10 页、带品牌；Plus：1,500 积分/月、单次 100 页、去品牌、高级图片模型；Pro：4,000/月、自定义品牌、分析与高级分享、10 个自定义域名；Ultra：20,000/月、最先进模型（文本/图像/视频）、100 个域名、优先新功能。
zh.UX_MON_HEADLINE: 体验与变现大体对齐，但在「第一次交差」这个点上是冲突的
zh.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: 对齐的部分：付费解锁的都是体验里立刻有感的能力（去品牌、页数、域名）。张力在实测里暴露得很直白——生成 20 张只给 10 张，用户还没验证「它到底适合我吗」就先遇到账单。它用配额换转化，代价是首付费的信任。
zh.COMP_1_D1: 全域设计工作台，演示只是其中一格
zh.COMP_1_D2: 自研设计引擎 + 多家生成模型接入
zh.COMP_1_D3: 设计工具存量用户、团队协作与素材库
zh.COMP_1_D4: 免费 + 订阅公开（本篇未逐一读价）
zh.COMP_2_D1: 商务演示，聚焦「排版不出错」
zh.COMP_2_D2: Smart Slides 规则化排版引擎
zh.COMP_2_D3: 团队演示、销售与咨询流程
zh.COMP_2_D4: 订阅档位公开（本篇未逐一读价）
zh.COMP_3_D2: 微软自有模型组合 + OpenAI 能力
zh.COMP_3_D3: Office 装机量与 M365 订阅，零迁移成本
zh.COMP_4_D1: 中文场景里「输入主题就出稿」
zh.COMP_4_D2: 模板库 + 第三方大模型接口
zh.COMP_4_D3: 中文互联网与微信生态，价格低、决策快
zh.COMP_4_D4: 免费额度 + 会员制（本篇未逐一读价）
zh.COMP_OWN_D1: 演示 + 文档 + 站点 + 社媒，一稿多形态
zh.COMP_OWN_D2: 多模型调度 + 自研编排与模板，不绑单一模型
zh.COMP_OWN_D3: 作品外溢 + 每月 3000 万个公开 gamma 的长尾
zh.COMP_OWN_D4: 四档订阅 + 积分，价格完全公开可算
zh.COMP_INTRO: 缺件先说：Product Hunt 产品页 403、G2 抓取失败，两个评论源都没拿到，所以这张地图不是从「用户的替代名单」里抄来的，而是按官网与各家公开页面上的定位摆的；竞品价格页本篇未逐一读取，凡没读到的价格一律不写。
zh.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: 一，审美密度与场景覆盖；二，一次输入多形态输出（演示/文档/网站/社媒/图片）；三，把「人类判断」做成流程节点，而不是一键到底；四，多模型调度，不把自己锁在某一家模型的能力曲线上。
zh.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: 在位者（Copilot、Canva）赢在「不用换工具」；国产赢在中文模板与价格；Beautiful.ai 赢在「布局确定性」这一件事上的专精。Gamma 的位置在中间：比在位者好看、比国产专业、比专才全能。
zh.CHANNEL_1: 模板与场景页吃搜索长尾（公开 gamma 页被搜索引擎大量收录）
zh.CHANNEL_2: 产品社区与创作者口碑（PH 产品页存在；本次评分抓取失败，不引分数）
zh.CHANNEL_3: 教育与专家场景的案例外溢（教师、顾问、创业 pitch 的成品自带出处）
zh.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: 实测：免费试用生成 20 张只给 10 张，下一步就是付费环节。用户在「还没确认它适合我」时先遇到账单，转化会来，信任会漏。
zh.FRICTION_2_TITLE: 审美会被自己的模板稀释
zh.FRICTION_2_BODY: 模板密度是它的护城河，也是它的同质化来源：用的人越多，「一看就是 Gamma」的观感越强，反而推动专业用户回到定制。
zh.FRICTION_3_TITLE: 中文与本土场景不是一等公民
zh.FRICTION_3_BODY: 英文优先的版式、素材与案例；中文排版、政务/国企风格、本土素材库要用户自己补，实测里也没有对中文效果的正面确认。
zh.FRICTION_4_TITLE: 能力上限跟着别人的发布走
zh.FRICTION_4_BODY: 模型是外采的（Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Flux 等），新模型一发布它才能用上；同时它要替用户承担调度与成本，涨价或限流都不完全在自己手里。
zh.METRICS_INTRO: 指标按三层摆：先看它自己公开承认的结果指标，再看能反推结果的输入指标，最后补一个没人量的盲点。
zh.NORTH_STAR_METRIC: 每月新建 gamma 数（公开自述约 3000 万/月）
zh.NORTH_STAR_WHY: 它自己把「新建数量」当成绩单（每天 100 万以上），因为这一个数同时代表活跃、使用深度和可被搜索引擎收录的公开作品量——增长与内容资产是同一个指标。
zh.INPUT_METRIC_1_WHY: 配额墙决定了转化发生在很早期，这一个比率直接决定新增付费的量级。
zh.INPUT_METRIC_2_NAME: 每付费账号的积分消耗
zh.INPUT_METRIC_2_WHY: 积分既是成本也是升级触发器；消耗接近上限的人，就是下一次升级的原型用户。
zh.INPUT_METRIC_3_NAME: 每账号发布页 / 自定义域名数
zh.INPUT_METRIC_3_WHY: 从「做稿」走到「上线」，是把工具用成基础设施的信号，留存最硬的指标。
zh.GUARDRAIL_METRIC: 撞墙后的流失率与退款率
zh.GUARDRAIL_WHY: 它是靠早付费墙赚钱的，护栏就该量「被墙挡住后走掉多少人」，而不是只看转化率。
zh.METRIC_BLINDSPOT: 成品质量（好看与可用）没有公开度量
zh.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: 数量指标无法区分「3000 万个被用过的作品」和「3000 万个被丢掉的草稿」；真正决定留存的审美与可用度，它没有对外披露任何口径。
zh.MOAT_REASONING_ONE_LINE: 护城河不在模型，在模板密度、场景库和「人类判断节点」的流程设计——能被追平，但要花时间与大量真实稿件。
zh.HORIZONTAL_1: 从演示扩到文档、网站、社媒图文与图片
zh.HORIZONTAL_2: 从个人扩到团队工作区、品牌资产与自定义域名托管
zh.VERTICAL_1: 咨询提案、销售材料、融资 pitch
zh.VERTICAL_2: 教育课件与培训材料、内部季度汇报
zh.PLATFORM_1: 公共 API：把 gamma 生成能力接进别人的系统
zh.PLATFORM_2: 25+ 连接器与导入导出：接既有素材源与 Office 生态
zh.OPP_1_HEADLINE: 做一个中文与本土场景的「版式层」
zh.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: 最轻的一刀：把中文排版规则（字重层级、标点、行距、图表标注）、政务/国企/教育常用版式做成可直接调用的模板包，接在 Gamma 这类工具之上或之内。为什么值得做：中文是最大单一内容市场之一，而这类平台的模板与案例以英文优先，本地化的缺口就是溢价空间。
zh.OPP_2_HEADLINE: 把「人类判断节点」做成可审阅的流程
zh.OPP_2_DETAIL: 最值的一刀：它已经把任务拆成多个确认节点，但没有把这些节点变成可留痕、可审批、可回滚的流程。企业真正想买的是「谁在哪一步改了什么」，把这层做出来，就能从「做稿工具」变成「对外表达的合规通道」。
zh.OPP_3_HEADLINE: 把原子能力做成别人的插座
zh.OPP_3_DETAIL: 最重的一刀：把「一段内容 → 一版可发的形态」拆成可调用的原子能力（大纲、版式、配图、多语种），以 API / 连接器 / agent 的形式嵌进别人的工作流——它自己想走的路，也是别人可以抢先占的位置。
zh.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: 从「生成工具」变成「组织对外的表达层」
zh.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: 把一次输入同时变成演示、文档、网站、社媒四件可发的东西，并把品牌规范、审批与版本管起来。谁占住「对外表达」这个入口，谁就不用和「哪个模型更强」赛跑——模型是耗材，表达层是资产。
zh.MOONSHOT_HEADLINE: 把「表达人格」做成可迁移的内核
zh.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: 把企业的品牌、历史稿件、语气与判断偏好训练成一个可迁移的「表达人格」：换任何格式、任何语言，出来的都是同一个人。做到这一步，竞争单位就从「一份稿」变成「一个组织的表达一致性」，品类天花板被抬到协作与知识管理那一层。
zh.RISK_INTRO: 四类风险，按「可能性 × 影响」摆；每条只写能指认的证据与能落地的缓解动作。
zh.RISK_1_MIT: 多模型并行（已做）+ 按环节压成本 + 把溢价从「模型能力」转向「模板与流程」
zh.RISK_2_MIT: 把「这次大概消耗多少积分、还能做几份」前置显示；首次撞墙给一次性宽限，而不是直接弹付费
zh.RISK_3_NAME: 模板同质化稀释「好看」的溢价
zh.RISK_3_MIT: 品牌主题与定制字体配色下沉到更低档位；给「不像模板」的设计自由度，而不是更多模板
zh.RISK_4_NAME: 在位者与国产低价双向挤压
zh.RISK_4_MIT: 守住「多形态 + 审美密度」两个在位者难转身的点；中文与本土场景主动本地化，别等被替代

zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_2: 把一篇长文自动拆成演示 + 社媒图文 + 落地页三件套
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_3: 按品牌规范批量产出季度汇报，版式与数据口径保持一致
zh.AI_DISRUPTION_RISK: 中：通用模型 + 通用模板正在把「生成一份好看的稿」压成基础能力，真正难替代的是场景判断与审美标准。
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_1: 中文与本土合规模板层（轻，可直接叠加）
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_2: 把判断节点做成可审阅、可留痕的流程（重，但是企业愿意付费的部分）
zh.ASSUMPTIONS_ONE_PARAGRAPH_LIST_WHAT_IS_I: 已知（有来源）：官网定位与能力清单、定价档位与积分额度、模型来源清单、规模与融资自述、以及 2026-11-23 的 20 分钟实测。推断（我的判断，标 [推断]）：模板同质化会稀释溢价；企业采购的决策点在合规与留痕而非生成质量；中文场景是本地化缺口。缺口（本次没拿到）：Product Hunt 与 G2 两个评论源全部失败，没有任何第三方评分与原话；定价页本身被 Cloudflare 403，价格取自官网定价页的公开摘要而非逐行读取；TTV、中文排版效果、API 实测均未测。
zh.ASSUMPTION_1: [推断] 模板密度越高，「好看」的边际溢价越低，最终要靠品牌定制与流程留痕守住价格——无数据支撑，仅有结构推理。
zh.ASSUMPTION_2: [推断] 企业版真正的决策点是 SSO、SOC 2、数据控制与留痕，而不是生成质量——依据是官网把这几项单独列为企业能力，未做访谈验证。
zh.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: 它站的位置是「视觉叙事」，不是「幻灯片」。这个类别命名很关键：一旦承认自己只是 PPT 工具，就要和 Office 装机量、和几十块一年的国产工具比价；说自己是「视觉叙事平台」，比价对象就变成设计师工时、外包报价和内容团队的人头。
zh.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: 当下的 AI 用法是「多模型流水线」：文本靠 Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini，图靠 Flux、Recraft、Ideogram、DALL·E、Luma、Leonardo，产品负责把每个环节挑一个合适的模型并串起来。所以它对外不宣传「我们的模型多强」，而是宣传「场景与效果」——模型是零件，编排才是产品。
zh.FINAL_BREAKS: 配额墙伤首付费信任；中文与本土场景弱；审美同质化；能力上限跟着外部模型走。
zh.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: 护城河在模板密度与流程设计，不在模型；6/10——能被追平，但要花时间与大量真实稿件积累。
zh.FINAL_WINS: 审美兜底（下限被抬起）、一稿多形态、多模型调度、免费起点低到可以立刻试。
zh.SIX_INTRO: 六维只填实测过的：2026-11-23，20 分钟，署名实测（燃冰），原始记录 `实测.md`。没测的写未测。
zh.AI_TYPE_REASON: 判定：嵌入式（实测判定，不是官方说法）。依据两条：一，模型是外采的（官网 FAQ 列了 Claude、ChatGPT + DALL·E、Gemini、Flux、Recraft、Playground、Ideogram、Luma、Leonardo）；二，拔电测试——拿走所有外部模型，剩下的模板库、布局引擎、编辑器、格式往返与发布能力仍然是一件能用的产品，只是不再生成。它的能力长在编排与审美，不长在模型。
zh.SIX_1: 替掉「做一版能给人看的稿」这一步：原来人自己做，做出来没审美，得找设计师或专业人士；现在它的场景库与工作流把审美兜住，把下限抬起来。实测原话：原来花钱也未必做好看，现在按月付费，年终结项就值得。
zh.SIX_2: 它啃审美、排版、配图、模板与导出；甩回两件：任务上下文（不给它就没法开工）与目标判断（把选择与判断交回给人）。实测判断：甩回的不是这个品类真正的门槛，是资源方的判断。
zh.SIX_3: 能直接用，而且能直接对外发——实测原话「它很好看」。改的不是格式而是目标，且可切颗粒度：智能布局与完全自由编辑之间来回切。
zh.SIX_4: 兜底靠规则校验：底座是一串工作流，给出指令后它会用交互把指令再拧清楚，前提给错它会来跟你确认。它兜的是「意图是否清楚」，不兜「事实对不对」——后者本卡不认为它有机制。
zh.SIX_5: 错得起：生成结果可以自己完全编辑。真正的代价是配额——实测免费试用生成 20 张只落 10 张，下一步就进付费环节。
zh.SIX_6: 豆包能顶一部分，但实测结论是「用过好的很难平替」——差在不够好用。换得掉，但成本大。

en.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: It does not sell slides. It sells a thought turning into something presentable, with taste built into the workflow and human judgement kept as checkpoints.
en.USER_SCALE: Two figures coexist, both quoted as published: the site claims a community of more than 100 million users; Gamma's own document page quotes founder Grant Lee (2025-11-10) with 70 million+ users worldwide and about 30 million gammas created monthly (over a million a day). The same page states over $100M ARR, profitable since 2023, more cash than raised, fewer than 50 people, and a $68M Series B led by a16z at a $2.1B valuation. The site number is the marketing figure; no reconciliation attempted here.
en.STAGE_MATURITY: Scaled and mature: a complete paywall (Free / Plus / Pro / Ultra / custom enterprise), outsourced models with in-house product, and roughly $100M ARR reported with fewer than 50 people - growth comes from template density and distribution, not headcount.
en.BUSINESS_MODEL_SHORT: Freemium plus credit-based subscriptions: Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra for individuals, enterprise and business seats by quote; credits are the universal unit.
en.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: It turned taste into an assembly line and left judgement as a human station - the wall is not generation, it is the density of scenarios and templates.
en.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: It is not one-prompt-to-deck: the job is split into nodes and a person confirms at several of them. Models are bought in; the product lives in orchestration and templates. So the threat is not a model being caught up, but taste becoming a default in every general tool.
en.TLDR_1_HEADLINE: Taste is the only irreplaceable thing
en.TLDR_1_BODY: The first reaction in the hand test was not that it generates, but that it looks good: built-in scenarios and layouts raise the floor, where the old choice was paying a designer or shipping something ugly.
en.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: The barrier is workflow design, not the model
en.TLDR_2_BODY: The models are Claude, ChatGPT + DALL-E, Gemini, Flux and others, per the site FAQ. The asset is the orchestration, the templates and the interaction - that is the part rivals cannot copy quickly.
en.TLDR_3_HEADLINE: The weakest beam: an early quota brake and a weak Chinese scenario
en.TLDR_3_BODY: In the hand test, asking for 20 generated items produced 10 and pushed straight to paid. The paywall stands very early, which converts but also leaks trust; and English-first templates leave Chinese layout to the user.
en.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: Gamma turns a written thought into something publishable: presentations, documents, websites, social visuals and images, with PPTX / PDF / PNG / Google Slides round-tripping, 25+ connectors and a public API.
en.USER_PROMISE: Stop paying a designer, or losing nights to layout, just to look presentable - describe the thing and let its scenarios and workflow carry the taste.
en.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: Three proposals a week, each must look sharp and must not look like a stock template; the first group named in the hand test. They buy speed plus professional appearance.
en.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: One piece of content must become a deck, a landing page and social posts; the second and third groups in the hand test. They buy one input, many output formats.
en.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: Courseware, training material, quarterly reviews; the site lists education, sales and startup pitches as scenarios. Price sensitive, but usage is steady.
en.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: Turn a thought into something sendable
en.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: Stop fearing that ugly output makes me look bad
en.JTBD_SOCIAL: Be seen as someone whose communication looks professional
en.FREQUENCY: Event driven but frequent: weekly reviews, proposals, quarterly reports, 2 to 8 times a month
en.USAGE_CONTEXT: Mostly desktop browser workspace; output flows back into PowerPoint, email, WeChat and websites
en.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: An occasion that requires external expression - a review, a proposal, a pitch, a class
en.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: Describe the need, pick scenario and style, review the outline, review the layout, confirm or rewrite node by node, then export or publish
en.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: A finished artifact you can put on screen or send as a link, not a draft
en.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: Brand themes, templates and past projects stay in the workspace, so the next deck starts from last time - switching cost becomes a retention reason
en.LOOP_FREQ: One full loop per artifact, 2 to 8 rounds a month
en.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: The trigger is a date on the calendar, not a product notification
en.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: It teaches a standard for what a good deck looks like, not a tool - use it long enough and your taste is calibrated by it.
en.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: Template and scenario pages harvest search long tail, generated work carries the origin, viewers ask what made it, and they come back as users.
en.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: The first time the output does not look like AI layout but like something you can present - the hand test reaction was simply that it looks good.
en.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: Weak social virality, strong artifact spillover: the output is an ad slot, but sharing-as-acquisition is not an explicit mechanism. The forced brand mark on free plans is the only guaranteed exposure.
en.RETENTION_1: Brand themes and workspace assets accumulate
en.RETENTION_2: The scenario library gets familiar; switching means relearning
en.RETENTION_3: PPTX export satisfies the day job - not locking formats lowers the psychological barrier
en.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: Millions of public gammas created monthly are themselves indexed long-tail pages, so content grows on its own
en.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: Finished work is projected, forwarded and embedded; every viewer is a candidate user, and the free-plan brand mark closes the loop tighter
en.SURFACE_1_ROLE: Entry: say what you need and get an outline and draft; the hand test noted the dialog carries scenario guidance that helps beginners
en.SURFACE_2_ROLE: Main workspace: smart layout and free editing are switchable, so the person decides the grain
en.SURFACE_3_ROLE: From Pro: custom branding, fonts and colours, so output looks like the company made it
en.SURFACE_4_ROLE: One piece becomes a deck, a document, a site, social visuals, images - the site writes this path as the core pitch
en.SURFACE_5_ROLE: Lossless PDF and PPTX import; export to PPTX / PDF / PNG / Google Slides; 25+ connectors into existing asset sources
en.SURFACE_6_ROLE: Custom domains (10 on Pro, 100 on Ultra) plus analytics, so output can go live as a website
en.ENTITY_1: Gamma (one artifact that is deck, doc and site at once)
en.ENTITY_2: Card (the smallest content unit, drag to reorder)
en.ENTITY_3: Theme / brand (the container that unifies visuals)
en.ENTITY_4: Credits (the pricing unit for AI actions)
en.ENTITY_5: Workspace (boundary for team assets and permissions)
en.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: The information architecture is artifact-first, not feature-first: one gamma is a document, a deck and a site at the same time, and format is decided at export. That order - content before form - is the structural difference from slide tools that open with a layout choice.
en.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: The interaction is talk first, typeset later: the dialog collects context, produces an outline, produces cards, and the person edits cards. The hand test noted deliberate human-judgement nodes inside the pipeline rather than one-click output, which is why it does not feel like a slot machine.
en.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: No blank canvas: it first asks what occasion you are making something for; the hand test says this helps beginners
en.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: By default you never touch pixels, but full control is there when you want it, and you can switch grain mid-project
en.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: The FAQ lists Claude, ChatGPT + DALL-E, Gemini, Flux, Recraft, Playground, Ideogram, Luma and Leonardo - pick per step, which is engineering rather than belief
en.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: PDF and PPTX keep their structure, admitting that users still report back into Office instead of forcing a move
en.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: Themes, templates and past projects are reusable, so the second deck is faster and delivery cost falls over time
en.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: The principle is taste as a default and judgement left to the human, which is why it does not chase full automation but turns every human choice into a station in the flow.
en.TTV_LABEL: Time to value: not measured this round (the hand test logged the sequence: understand the scenario, open the workspace, order via dialog, get a draft, edit until presentable)
en.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: No stopwatch and no minute-level record, so this card neither converts to minutes nor invents a score. What is confirmed: several scenario and judgement questions come before the first usable draft.
en.COG_LABEL: Cognitive load: low (the dialog carries scenario guidance, so nobody learns layout first; the hard part is knowing what effect you want, not where the button is)
en.DELIGHT_1: Never a blank page: scenarios and templates lift the floor to not-ugly
en.DELIGHT_2: Same content, other formats: deck, doc, site, social in one pass
en.DELIGHT_3: Directly publishable - the hand test said it looks good, no designer pass needed
en.DELIGHT_LABEL: Delight: taste insurance, one draft many formats, output that can ship
en.TRUST_LABEL: Trust: model sources are public (each vendor listed in the FAQ), and the enterprise tier lists SSO, SOC 2 documents and data controls. The gap: both review sources failed this round (Product Hunt 403, G2 scrape failure), so there is no third-party rating cited here.
en.STRUGGLE_1: An early quota brake: 400 free credits, 10 slides per prompt, and asking for 20 in the hand test yielded 10 before the paywall
en.STRUGGLE_2: Taste convergence: the denser the templates, the easier it is to spot that something was made in Gamma
en.STRUGGLE_3: Chinese and local scenarios: English-first layouts and assets leave Chinese typesetting and local cases to the user
en.STRUGGLE_LABEL: Friction: quota wall, template convergence, Chinese scenarios
en.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: Four individual tiers (Plus US$9/month, Pro US$18/month, Ultra US$90/month at annual billing, i.e. US$108 / 216 / 1080 a year) plus business and enterprise priced per member; credits are consumed per action and billing is per account, so more members means more seats.
en.MON_ENTRY_HEADLINE: The entry point does not give the job away: 400 credits is enough to try, not enough to ship
en.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: Free credits only cover learning the product, and the 10-slide cap sits exactly at can-look-but-cannot-deliver; the natural move at the first block is to upgrade to Plus.
en.FREE_PAID_BOUNDARY_NAME: The wall is how much one prompt can produce and whether the brand mark goes away
en.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: Free: 400 credits at signup, max 10 slides per prompt, branded. Plus: 1,500 credits a month, 100 slides per prompt, branding removed, advanced image models. Pro: 4,000 a month, custom branding, analytics and advanced sharing, 10 custom domains. Ultra: 20,000 a month, the most advanced text, image and video models, 100 domains, early access.
en.UX_MON_HEADLINE: Experience and monetisation mostly align, but they collide exactly at the first delivery
en.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: Aligned: paid unlocks what you feel immediately (branding, slide caps, domains). The tension showed plainly in the hand test - asking for 20 items delivered 10, so the bill arrives before the user has verified fit. Quotas buy conversion at the cost of first-payment trust.

en.COMP_INTRO: Missing piece first: the Product Hunt product page returned 403 and the G2 scrape failed, so neither review source is available. This map is therefore positioned from official pages rather than from users' substitute lists, and competitor pricing pages were not read one by one, so no unread prices appear.
en.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: One: taste density and scenario coverage. Two: one input, many output formats. Three: human judgement as pipeline stations instead of one click. Four: multi-model routing, so it does not ride a single capability curve.
en.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: Incumbents win on not switching tools; Chinese tools win on local templates and price; Beautiful.ai wins on layout certainty. Gamma sits in between - better looking than incumbents, more polished than local tools, broader than specialists.
en.CHANNEL_1: Template and scenario pages harvest search long tail (public gamma pages are widely indexed)
en.CHANNEL_2: Product communities and creator word of mouth (the PH page exists; the rating scrape failed, so no score is cited)
en.CHANNEL_3: Education and expert case spillover (teachers, consultants, pitch decks carry the origin)
en.FRICTION_1_TITLE: The quota wall stands too early
en.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: Hand test: asking for 20 generated items delivered 10, and the next step was payment. The bill arrives before fit is established - conversion comes, trust leaks.
en.FRICTION_2_TITLE: Taste diluted by its own templates
en.FRICTION_2_BODY: Template density is the moat and the source of sameness: the more people use it, the more recognisable the look, which pushes professionals back to custom work.
en.FRICTION_3_TITLE: Chinese and local scenarios are second class
en.FRICTION_3_BODY: English-first layouts, assets and cases; Chinese typesetting, government and state-owned styles and local asset libraries must be supplied by the user, and the hand test gave no positive confirmation on Chinese output.
en.FRICTION_4_TITLE: The ceiling follows someone else's release calendar
en.FRICTION_4_BODY: Models are bought in (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Flux and others), so new capability arrives when vendors ship. It also absorbs routing and cost on the user's behalf, yet pricing and rate limits are not fully in its hands.
en.METRICS_INTRO: Three layers of metrics: the outcome it publishes, the inputs that drive that outcome, and one blind spot nobody measures.
en.NORTH_STAR_METRIC: Gammas created per month (about 30 million, self-reported)
en.NORTH_STAR_WHY: It treats creation volume as the scoreboard (over a million a day) because that single number encodes activity, depth of use and the amount of indexed public work - growth and content assets are the same metric.
en.INPUT_METRIC_1_WHY: The quota wall forces conversion very early, so this ratio drives new paid volume directly.
en.INPUT_METRIC_2_WHY: Credits are both cost and upgrade trigger; accounts near the cap are the prototype for the next tier.
en.INPUT_METRIC_3_NAME: Published pages and custom domains per account
en.INPUT_METRIC_3_WHY: Moving from making decks to going live turns the tool into infrastructure - the hardest retention signal.
en.GUARDRAIL_METRIC: Churn and refunds after hitting the wall
en.GUARDRAIL_WHY: It monetises through an early paywall, so the guardrail should measure how many leave after being blocked, not just the conversion rate.
en.METRIC_BLINDSPOT: Output quality (looking and working well) has no public measure
en.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: A volume metric cannot separate 30 million used artifacts from 30 million abandoned drafts, and the taste and usability that decide retention are not disclosed anywhere.
en.MOAT_REASONING_ONE_LINE: The moat is not the model but template density, the scenario library and a workflow that keeps human judgement as stations - catchable, but only with time and a lot of real drafts.
en.HORIZONTAL_1: From decks to documents, websites, social visuals and images
en.HORIZONTAL_2: From individuals to team workspaces, brand assets and hosted custom domains
en.VERTICAL_1: Consulting proposals, sales material, fundraising pitches
en.VERTICAL_2: Courseware and training material, internal quarterly reviews
en.PLATFORM_1: Public API: put gamma generation inside other systems
en.PLATFORM_2: 25+ connectors and round-tripping: attach to existing asset sources and the Office ecosystem
en.OPP_1_HEADLINE: Build a Chinese and local-scenario layout layer
en.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: The lightest cut: package Chinese typesetting rules (weight hierarchy, punctuation, leading, chart labels) and the layouts used in government, state-owned and education settings as a directly callable template pack, on top of or inside tools like Gamma. Why: Chinese is one of the largest single content markets, and these platforms are English-first, so the localisation gap is where premium pricing lives.
en.OPP_2_HEADLINE: Turn the judgement stations into a reviewable process
en.OPP_2_DETAIL: The most valuable cut: the task is already split into confirmation nodes, but those nodes are not traceable, approvable or reversible. What enterprises actually buy is who changed what, and at which step - build that and the product moves from deck tool to compliance-grade channel for external communication.
en.OPP_3_HEADLINE: Make the atomic capability a socket for others
en.OPP_3_DETAIL: The heaviest cut: break content-to-format into callable atoms (outline, layout, imagery, multilingual) and embed them through API, connectors or agents into other workflows - the road Gamma wants to take is also the position someone else can occupy first.
en.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: From generation tool to the organisation's external expression layer
en.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: Turn one input into four publishable things - deck, document, site, social - and govern brand rules, approvals and versions. Whoever owns the external expression entry point no longer races on which model is stronger: models are consumables, the expression layer is the asset.
en.MOONSHOT_HEADLINE: Make expression persona a portable core
en.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: Train a company's brand, past drafts, tone and judgement preferences into a portable expression persona, so any format or language still sounds like the same organisation. At that point the unit of competition shifts from a single deck to expressional consistency across an organisation, and the ceiling rises into collaboration and knowledge management.
en.RISK_INTRO: Four risks placed by likelihood times impact; each entry carries identifiable evidence and a mitigations that can actually be executed.
en.RISK_1_MIT: Run models in parallel (already done), compress cost per step, and shift the premium from model capability to templates and process
en.RISK_2_NAME: The quota wall damages first-payment trust
en.RISK_2_MIT: Show expected credit cost and remaining capacity before generation; give a one-time grace at the first block instead of a paywall prompt
en.RISK_3_NAME: Template convergence dilutes the good-looking premium
en.RISK_3_MIT: Move brand themes, custom fonts and colours to lower tiers; sell freedom from templates rather than more templates
en.RISK_4_NAME: Squeezed by incumbents and cheap local tools
en.RISK_4_MIT: Defend the two things incumbents cannot turn quickly - multi-format output and taste density - and localise Chinese scenarios before someone else does

Inferred (marked [inferred]): template convergence erodes the good-looking premium; enterprise buying hinges on compliance and traceability rather than generation quality; Chinese scenarios are the localisation gap. en.ASSUMPTION_2: [inferred] Enterprise decisions hinge on SSO, SOC 2, data controls and traceability rather than generation quality - based on the site listing those as enterprise capabilities, not on interviews.
en.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: It stands in visual storytelling, not slideware. The category name matters: admit being a slide tool and you are compared with Office install base and with tools that cost a few dozen yuan a year; claim visual storytelling and the comparison becomes designer hours, agency quotes and content headcount.
en.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: The current AI usage is a multi-model pipeline: text from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, images from Flux, Recraft, Ideogram, DALL-E, Luma or Leonardo, with the product choosing a model per step. That is why it never advertises how strong its model is - the model is a part, the orchestration is the product.
en.FINAL_BREAKS: The quota wall hurts first-payment trust; Chinese and local scenarios are thin; taste converges; the ceiling follows external models.
en.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: The moat is template density and process design, not the model: 6/10 - catchable, but only with time and many real drafts.
en.FINAL_WINS: Taste insurance, one draft many formats, multi-model routing, and a free entry low enough to try immediately.
en.SIX_INTRO: All six dimensions come from the hand test only: 2026-11-23, 20 minutes, credited to RanBing, raw record in the test sheet. Anything untested is marked untested.
en.AI_TYPE_REASON: Verdict: embedded (from the hand test, not an official claim). Two reasons: models are bought in (the FAQ lists Claude, ChatGPT + DALL-E, Gemini, Flux, Recraft, Playground, Ideogram, Luma, Leonardo), and the pull-the-plug test - remove every external model and the template library, layout engine, editor, format round trip and publishing still form a usable product that simply stops generating. The capability lives in orchestration and taste, not in a model.
en.SIX_1: It replaces making a presentable draft: that used to be done by hand with poor taste, then a designer or a professional. Now the scenario library and workflow carry the taste and raise the floor. Hand test: it used to cost money and still look bad; at a monthly fee it is worth it at year-end close.
en.SIX_2: It takes taste, layout, imagery, templates and export; it hands back two things: task context (nothing starts without it) and goal judgement (choices and calls stay with the person). Hand test view: what is handed back is not the real barrier of this category, it is the judgement of whoever owns the resources.
en.SIX_3: Directly usable and directly publishable - the hand test said it looks good. What you change is the goal rather than the format, and the grain is switchable between smart layout and fully free editing.
en.SIX_4: The fallback is rules-based: the base is a series of workflows, and after the instruction it tightens the instruction through interaction, confirming when a premise looks wrong. It guards whether intent is clear, not whether facts are true - this card does not believe it has a mechanism for the latter.
en.SIX_5: Mistakes are cheap: generated output is fully editable. The real cost is quota - asking for 20 items on the free trial produced 10 and moved straight into payment.
en.SIX_6: Doubao can cover part of it, but the hand test concluded a good tool is hard to replace with a merely adequate one. Replaceable, at a real cost.

extra_zh.title: 对标竞品地图
extra_zh.body:
缺件先说：Product Hunt 产品页直连 403、G2 抓取失败，两个评论源全都没拿到，所以这张地图不是从「用户自己说的替代」里抄来的，而是按各家公开页面上的定位摆的；竞品定价页本次未逐一读取，凡没读到的价格一律不写。

谁抢同一个需求抢同一段链路用户实际会往哪走
Canva（Magic Studio）要一套能出所有物料的工具设计 → 演示 → 社媒，同一素材库最大的平替：已经付了订阅的人不会再买一个只做演示的
Beautiful.ai要「排版绝不会崩」的商务演示版式规则引擎这一段对确定性要求高于审美的人留下，其余流向 Gamma
PowerPoint + Copilot不想换工具的人Office 存量工作流企业内部的默认选项，靠装机量与 M365 账单守住
AiPPT 等国产中文场景里「输入主题就出稿」模板库 + 低价价格敏感与中文优先的用户在这里，向上迁移的动力弱

真正的位置差：Gamma 是唯一把「演示 + 文档 + 站点 + 社媒」当成一件事做的，而在位者各自只占其中一格；但它也是最容易被「够用就好」的国产工具从下面掏空的。

extra_zh.title: 竞品技术底座
extra_zh.body:
比技术底座，比的不是谁模型强，而是谁把不稳定的东西变成了稳定的输出。

  • Gamma：多模型调度（Claude / ChatGPT + DALL·E / Gemini / Flux / Recraft / Playground / Ideogram / Luma / Leonardo，官网 FAQ 自述）+ 自研编排、模板与卡片布局引擎 + 格式往返。接缝在「外部模型换代」——每次新模型发布，它要重新调一轮提示与成本。
  • Canva：自研设计引擎是真正的底座，生成模型是补位，优势在素材库与协作。
  • Beautiful.ai：Smart Slides 是一套规则系统，把内容约束成不会出错的版式，稳定但不自由。
  • Copilot：能力长在 Office 的文件模型与租户权限里，天然合规，天然不惊艳。

[推断] 真正的护城河不在参数量，在「同一份内容换四种形态还不崩」这件事上——这靠模板与渲染管线的工程积累，不靠模型代际。

extra_zh.title: 可迁移的机会（我的判断）
extra_zh.body:
三个方向，按投入从轻到重排，每个都配一句「为什么是你」。

  1. 中文与本土场景的「版式层」（最轻）：中文排版规则、政务/国企/教育常用版式做成可调用模板包，接在 Gamma 这类工具之上。为什么：这些平台英文优先，本地化缺口就是溢价空间。
  2. 把判断节点做成可审阅流程（最值）：它已经把任务拆成多个确认点，但没有留痕、审批与回滚。企业买的是「谁在哪一步改了什么」，这层做出来，工具就变成合规通道。
  3. 把原子能力做成插座（最重）：大纲、版式、配图、多语种拆成可调用能力，以 API / 连接器 / agent 形式嵌进别人的工作流。它自己想走的路，也是别人可以抢先占的位置。

哪个最轻？第一个。哪个最值？第二个。哪个最难被追平？第三个。

extra_zh.title: 流量与变现拆解
extra_zh.body:
钱从谁兜里出、还能拿多久、凭什么你拿到——三问一次说清。

钱从谁的兜里出：原本付给设计师、PPT 外包、内容团队的预算，本质是替掉「把想法做得好看」这份工时；企业侧则是替掉一堆分散的排版与素材采购。

还能拿多久：窗口在收窄。通用模型让「生成一份能看的稿」快速变成基础能力，剩余溢价只能来自审美标准、场景密度和流程留痕。它自己公布的数字（1 亿美元 ARR、7000 万+ 用户、每月 3000 万个 gamma）说明窗口今天还开着，但数字越大，越说明这件事正在被普及。

凭什么你拿到：四层叠加——模板与场景的密度、一稿多形态的输出面、多模型调度带来的效果上限、以及公开作品带来的搜索长尾。最脆的梁是那道过早的配额墙：实测生成 20 张只落 10 张，用户在确认「适不适合我」之前就遇到账单。

extra_en.title: Competitor technical base
extra_en.body:
Comparing technical bases is not about whose model is stronger, but who turns an unstable input into a stable output.

  • Gamma: multi-model routing (Claude / ChatGPT + DALL-E / Gemini / Flux / Recraft / Playground / Ideogram / Luma / Leonardo, per the FAQ) plus in-house orchestration, templates and a card layout engine, plus format round-tripping. The seam is model rotation: every new model means another round of prompt and cost tuning.
  • Canva: the design engine is the base; generative models fill gaps; strength is the asset library and collaboration.
  • Beautiful.ai: Smart Slides is a rule system constraining content into layouts that cannot break - stable, not free.
  • Copilot: capability lives in the Office file model and tenant permissions - compliant by construction, rarely striking.

[inferred] The moat is not parameter count; it is the engineering that keeps one piece of content coherent across four formats, which comes from templates and a rendering pipeline, not from model generations.

extra_en.title: Transferable opportunities (my judgement)
extra_en.body:
Three directions ordered by investment, each with a why-you line.

  1. A Chinese and local-scenario layout layer (lightest): Chinese typesetting rules and the layouts used in government, state-owned and education settings as a callable template pack on top of tools like Gamma. Why: these platforms are English-first, so the localisation gap is where premium pricing lives.
  2. Judgement stations as a reviewable process (most valuable): the task is already split into confirmation points but has no trace, approval or rollback. Enterprises buy who changed what at which step; build that and the tool becomes a compliance channel.
  3. Atomic capability as a socket (heaviest): outline, layout, imagery and multilingual as callable pieces embedded through API, connectors or agents into other workflows - the road Gamma wants is the position someone else can take first.

Lightest? The first. Most valuable? The second. Hardest to catch up with? The third.

extra_en.title: Traffic and monetisation
extra_en.body:
Whose budget, for how long, and why you - in one pass.

Whose budget: money that used to go to designers, deck agencies and content teams, essentially replacing the labour of making an idea look good; on the enterprise side, it replaces scattered layout and asset purchasing.

For how long: the window is narrowing. General models are turning generate a presentable draft into a baseline, so the remaining premium has to come from taste standards, scenario density and process traceability. Its own published numbers ($100M ARR, 70M+ users, 30M gammas a month) say the window is open today - and the bigger the numbers, the more clearly the capability is becoming ubiquitous.

Why you: four layers - template and scenario density, multi-format output surface, multi-model routing that lifts the quality ceiling, and the search long tail of public work. The weakest beam is the early quota wall: asking for 20 items produced 10, so the bill arrives before the user has confirmed fit.
